title: The Holy Sect Appears
next_chapter_hook: The Holy Sect Elder sneered coldly: 'Chen Nian's value is far greater than you imagine, waste.'

text.content:
In the silence following the dissolution of the remnant soul, Chen Ji stood in place, his surrounding spiritual energy chaotic like leaves in a gale. 'Your father once came here'—these words were like a blunt knife, repeatedly cutting into his already scarred heart.

He slowly clenched his fist until his knuckles turned white. Twelve years had passed. He had believed his father died in an accident, that the gentle man had simply fallen off a cliff while gathering herbs. But now, a dust-laden door was slowly opening before him, and behind it lay truths that could overturn his entire understanding.

'Father... what exactly did you get involved in?' Chen Ji murmured, his voice hoarse and nearly incoherent. The Tianji Record in his Mental Sea trembled slightly, as if responding to his emotions, yet could offer no answers.

Just then—

A suffocating pressure erupted from the depths of the ruins with devastating force. Like tangible black fog rolling over everything, it swept forward. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. That level of pressure was far beyond anything he had ever encountered.

As the black fog dispersed, a figure stepped out from the void.

It was an elderly man with crane-white hair yet youthful complexion, clad in a dark purple robe with eerie purple-black patterns coiling around him like living things. His face was benevolent, but the indifference in his eyes made one's blood run cold, as if looking at an ant that could be crushed at any moment.

'Tianqing Sect's servant disciple?' The old man glanced around, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment. His lips curved slightly upward. 'Such insignificant creatures, yet gathered here quite completely.'

dialogue.content: 'The guardian's remnant soul has finally dispersed?' The old man glanced casually at where the guardian had vanished. 'I thought it could hold on longer.没想到如此不堪。'

text.content:
Chen Ji's blood nearly froze.

The guardian—that remnant soul was the last protection left by his father, one of the only warmths he had in this world. Yet this old man casually dismissed it with the word 'insignificant', as if it were not a presence that had guarded him for years, but a withered leaf that could be discarded.

'Who are you?' Chen Ji forced himself to speak, yet his voice couldn't help but tremble slightly. 'This is a Tianqing Sect ruin. Please show some restraint, Senior.'

dialogue.content: 'Tianqing Sect?' The old man actually laughed. That laughter was clear and pleasant, yet it made Chen Ji feel cold to the bone. 'The three major sects are nothing but slightly larger grasshoppers in my eyes. You think you can use them to pressure me?'

text.content:
The old man's pressure was like a mountain collapsing. Chen Ji's knees bent slightly, nearly forcing him to his knees. He bit his tongue hard, the sweet taste of blood barely allowing him to maintain his standing posture.

'A force above the three major sects...' Countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind at lightning speed. 'Holy Sect! You're from the Holy Sect!'

dialogue.content: 'Oh?' A hint of surprise flashed in the old man's eyes. 'An ant actually has some knowledge. This one is Mu Chen, Outer Sect Elder of the Holy Sect.' His tone was casual, as if this identity was of no consequence. 'This journey is merely to claim something that should rightfully belong to the Holy Sect.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. 'Claim?' He forced himself to remain composed. 'What the Senior refers to—is it the Tianji Record?'

dialogue.content: 'Tianji Record?' Mu Chen sneered. 'That broken thing is beneath my notice. What I want is the 'Heavenly Fate Key'—' His gaze slowly移向陈机，仿佛在看一只待宰的羔羊，'你那位失踪多年的妹妹，陈念。'

text.content:
This name was like thunder exploding in Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

Chen Nian. His younger sister. The woman whose face had become a blur in his memory, the close relative he had sworn to find in this lifetime. Taken away by the Holy Sect twelve years ago, her whereabouts unknown. He had thought she must have died long ago, but never expected—

'You...' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse beyond recognition, blood vessels spreading across his pupils. 'What have you done to her!'

dialogue.content: Mu Chen watched Chen Ji's twisted expression, not only unmoved but wearing a playful smile. 'Why so agitated? She's very much alive, living far better than you, you waste.' He casually straightened his sleeves. 'However, her current status is this sect's 'Heavenly Fate Key', used to unlock certain... restrictions.'

choice.prompt: Upon learning that Chen Nian is imprisoned in the Holy Sect, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Even knowing he cannot win, he must still declare his stance. His resolve to free his sister shall never waver. Even if he dies here today, he must let the Holy Sect know that the Chen family is not some soft persimmon to be squeezed at will.
choices.visible_reward: Guardian remnant soul's approval, unlocking hidden clues
choices.risk_hint: The opponent's strength is unfathomable, acting rashily means nine deaths out of ten

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his blood-red eyes burning with near-mad rage. He slowly loosened his clenched fist, yet the spiritual energy around him was surging in an almost self-destructive manner.

'The Chen family...' His voice was terrifyingly low, like echoes from the abyss. 'Never kneels to survive.'

choices.description: When strength is vastly unequal, rashly showing one's hand serves no purpose. Calmly gather intelligence on the Holy Sect, secretly lay plans while waiting for the right moment to counterattack. Only by surviving is there hope of rescuing Chen Nian.
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial intelligence on the Holy Sect, unlock hidden questline
choices.risk_hint: 对方可能步步紧逼，试探你的底线

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly pressing the boiling rage into the deepest part of his heart. His expression returned to calm, as if the earlier loss of composure was merely an illusion.

"Your junior presumes to ask, Senior——" He slightly bowed, his tone respectful yet neither servile nor overbearing, "Where exactly is my sister?"

dialogue.content: Mu Chen narrowed his eyes, examining Chen Ji, "Interesting. Just moments ago you looked ready to fight to the death, and now you can suppress your anger?" His smile grew more playful, "No wonder the Tianji Record chose you——this ability to endure, it does have a hint of Chen Xuan from back then."

text.content:
Chen Xuan.

That was the name of Chen Ji's father. Spoken from the mouth of the Holy Sect Elder at this moment, it carried an indescribable implication. Was it regret? Mockery? Or some kind of ineffable emotion?

"Does Senior know my father?" Chen Ji's voice slightly trembled, and this time it was not fear, but a near instinctive longing.

dialogue.content: "More than just knowing." Mu Chen stood with hands behind his back, his gaze distant, "Twenty years ago, he was also a piece I favored. Unfortunately... he was too ungrateful."

text.content:
A piece.

Chen Ji felt dizzy. His father did not die in an accident, did not die in the mouth of a demonic beast, but was used as a piece by the Holy Sect, ultimately because he was "ungrateful"...

He dared not continue thinking.

"The criteria for the Tianji Record to select people is never talent, never strength." Mu Chen seemed to see through Chen Ji's confusion, "It is——whether one can bear the weight of fate itself. Unfortunately, your father could not bear it."

choice.prompt: Does Chen Ji want to know more about the truth concerning his father?

choices.description: Since he has come this far, there is no turning back. Even the cruelest truth, he must hear with his own ears.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden plotline related to the father
choices.risk_hint: The other party may use this as a bargaining chip

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, every word seeming to be forced out from between his teeth: "My father... what was his final fate?"

choices.description: Exposing emotions before an enemy is foolish. Redirect the topic to Chen Nian, first ensure the younger sister's safety, personal grievances can be settled later.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on the Holy Sect's layout
choices.risk_hint: The other party may see through your intentions

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. When he opened them again, his gaze had regained clarity, his voice calm to the point of coldness: "My sister... how is she now?"

dialogue.content: Mu Chen seemed very satisfied with Chen Ji's reaction. "You are more composed than your father." He nodded lightly, "Rest assured, your sister will not die for now. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key requires a complete soul to function, our sect cannot afford to have even a trace of damage to her."

text.content:
Chen Ji's fists clenched in his sleeves, fingernails deeply embedded in his palms.

For now.

This word was like a poisoned barb, deeply piercing his heart. "For now" meant there was a deadline, "for now" meant it could become "forever" at any moment. He had to find Chen Nian as soon as possible, had to rescue her before she became a true "Lock Key".

But the Holy Sect——that was an existence even the Three Great Sects could only look up to. He, a mere Foundation Building waste, by what right?

dialogue.content: "Are you thinking about how to rescue her?" Mu Chen suddenly laughed out loud, that smile filled with pity and mockery, "This one will point out a clear path for you——give up this notion. With your talent, if you can reach Golden Core stage in this lifetime, you should be thanking the heavens. And in our sect, any Inner Disciple who steps out could crush the leaders of the Three Great Sects."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak.

He simply stood there quietly, head bowed, like an ant that had been completely defeated. Seeing this, Mu Chen grew even more smug, continuing, "However, if you are willing to cooperate obediently, this one could arrange a servant's job for you in the sect. At least..."

choice.prompt: Facing Mu Chen's recruitment and humiliation, how does Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Appear to accept on the surface
choices.description: A true man can bend and stretch. Pretend to submit to the Holy Sect, infiltrate the enemy's interior, both preserve one's life and get close to Chen Nian to find rescue opportunities.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the infamy of betraying the sect
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the Holy Sect infiltration side quest, obtain a crucial intelligence channel
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, death is certain, and may be used to threaten Chen Nian

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a smile uglier than crying spreading across his face. "The senior speaks truly... I am merely a waste, how would I dare oppose the Holy Sect?" His voice was utterly humble, yet a hidden glint flickered in the depths of his eyes.

choices.description: Better to die standing than live kneeling. Today's humiliation will be repaid a hundredfold! Even if crushed to pieces, I will never be a dog of the Holy Sect!
choices.visible_reward: Trigger hidden plot: Tianji Record initiates active warning for the first time
choices.risk_hint: May suffer severe injuries on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly straightened his spine, the eyes that had always been lowered finally lifting to face Mu Chen directly. "Though I am a waste, I still remember my surname." His voice was not loud, yet every word was crystal clear, "A person of the Chen family does not become a servant of a second surname."

dialogue.content: Mu Chen's expression darkened slightly. "You won't take the respectful wine but insist on the punishing kind." He raised his hand, purple-black spiritual energy condensing into an ominous sphere of light between his fingers, "I wanted to spare your life, but since you refuse to appreciate the gesture—"

text.content:
In that critical moment, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly shuddered, and an unprecedented message flooded into his mind—

【Heavenly Fate: 5/100】
【Warning: Detecting Heavenly Fate Lock Key aura, interfering with foresight precision】
【Current Prediction: Thirty zhang behind Mu Chen, there is an extremely faint spatial fluctuation】

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Spatial fluctuation? Someone is lurking nearby?

dialogue.content:
Mu Chen seemed to sense something, his brow furrowing as his gaze swept across the void behind him. "Who's there?" His pressure spread outward like a tide, yet discovered nothing. That spatial fluctuation had already vanished.

"Hmph." Mu Chen withdrew his gaze, looking at Chen Ji, "It seems this waste has some tricks after all. The warning function of the Tianji Record? No wonder this seat always felt your aura was somewhat strange."

text.content:
A mighty storm raged in Chen Ji's heart, yet his expression remained unmoved.

What did that spatial fluctuation mean? Were other Holy Sect members monitoring them, or... some other faction? And why would Chen Nian's aura interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight? The Heavenly Fate Lock Key—what secrets lay behind that name?

Questions surged like a tide, but there was no time for deliberation. Mu Chen had already withdrawn his killing intent and turned toward the depths of the ruins.

"Forget it. This seat has important matters today." His voice drifted from the distance, "That ant... this seat can crush it whenever. But given your somewhat useful value, I'll let you go today. Remember—"

dialogue.content: Mu Chen's silhouette gradually dissolved into the black mist, leaving behind only words echoing in the ruins: "The whereabouts of that sister of yours, this seat can tell you—come ask when you can stand firm before this seat. Waste."

text.content:
Chen Ji stood alone in the vast ruins, surrounded only by the faint light remaining after the guardian's residual soul dissipated.

His fists clenched until they creaked, his knuckles white. Waste. Waste. Waste. The word from Mu Chen's mouth carried a condescending pity, as if he truly was just an ant that could be crushed at any moment.

"I remember." Chen Ji said quietly, his voice terrifyingly calm, "Today's humiliation will be repaid."

He slowly closed his eyes, carving every detail of today deep into his memory.

Holy Sect. Mu Chen. Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Chen Nian. Father Chen Xuan. And that诡异 spatial fluctuation—all of it pointed to a chess game far grander than he had imagined.

And he stood at the edge of the board, treated as a discarded piece.

But so what?

"Those chosen by the Tianji Record—" Chen Ji opened his eyes, his crimson pupils reflecting the ruins' eerie glow, "Will never be mere pieces."

A low rumble suddenly echoed from the depths of the ruins, and the entire space began to shake violently. The formation left by the dissipating guardian's residual soul was collapsing—the inheritance here was about to be completely sealed.

Chen Ji did not hesitate, turning to sprint back the way he came. Mu Chen's words kept echoing in his mind—"Come ask when you can stand firm before this seat."

Very well. He recited silently in his heart, his gaze cold as frost.

Then he would show the entire Holy Sect how a "waste" climbs step by step to stand above them all.

Just as Chen Ji was about to leave the ruins, a faint voice suddenly rang in his ear—

"Brother..."

The voice was as light as a mosquito's whine, yet crystal clear. Chen Ji's footsteps halted abruptly, his entire body going rigid.

Chen Nian? Was that Chen Nian's voice?

He spun around sharply, only to see the collapsing ruins and rubble. Nothing was there.

That voice was like a hallucination, vanishing in an instant.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions.

Whether hallucination or premonition, he had to first survive and leave this place. Chen Nian was in the Holy Sect, in a place he currently could not reach at all. But as long as she was alive, as long as he still had breath, there was hope.

"Wait for me." Chen Ji said quietly, his voice hoarse yet resolute, "Brother will definitely come to rescue you."

With that, his figure vanished into the collapsing ruins' entrance. And behind him, a vague silhouette stood on a distant mountain peak, watching all of this unfold.
